$comment: The only place a security/<rule> ID's source is written (docs/intents/oxlint-plugin-security-drop-in, R2). index.js builds the plugin from this file; scripts/generate-oxlint-security.ts derives the README table and index.d.ts from it.

detect-no-csrf-before-method-override.reason: Matches only express.csrf() and express.methodOverride(), the Express 3 built-ins. On Express 4.22.3 reading express.csrf throws ("Most middleware (like csrf) is no longer bundled"); on 5.3.0 both are undefined. The defect cannot be written against a supported Express.

detect-pseudoRandomBytes.reason: crypto.pseudoRandomBytes === crypto.randomBytes on every supported Node (measured true on 24 versions from 18.16.1 to 26.10.0, 2026-10-25): the API is the CSPRNG, so the defect cannot occur.
